meta.name: notebooklm
meta.description: Complete API for Google NotebookLM - full programmatic access including features not in the web UI. Create notebooks, add sources, generate all artifact types, download in multiple formats. Activates on explicit /notebooklm or intent like "create a podcast about X"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码自动操作 NotebookLM 生成学习内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把 NotebookLM 的能力编入自己的程序或工作流。
copy.tagline_en: Automate NotebookLM with code to create study content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to integrate NotebookLM into your own apps or workflows.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接操作 Google NotebookLM：新建笔记本、导入网页/PDF/视频等资料，生成播客、测验、闪卡等成果，还能下载。你只需用日常话提要求。
howto.when: 当你说出“/notebooklm”或“使用notebooklm”，或提出“把……做成播客”“总结这些网页”等意图时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个关于人工智能的播客
say.note: Claude 会调用 NotebookLM 生成音频概述。

say.text: 把这些网页链接加进笔记，并总结要点
say.note: 添加来源后自动生成摘要。

say.text: 把这份PDF内容做成测验题

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate Google NotebookLM directly: create notebooks, add sources (URLs, PDFs, videos, etc.), generate podcasts, quizzes, flashcards, and download results. You can just ask in plain language.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user says '/notebooklm' or expresses intent like 'create a podcast about X' or 'summarize these URLs'.

say_en.text: Create a podcast about artificial intelligence.
say_en.note: Claude generates an audio overview via NotebookLM.

say_en.text: Add these URLs and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Adds sources and produces a summary.

say_en.text: Turn this PDF into a quiz.
say_en.note: Generates quiz questions from the document.
